actual_training_stream.note: Each CSV row is one saved actual optimizer batch. Repeated steps across attempts are retained explicitly. No historical per-step gradient was recorded or reconstructed here.

frozen_gradient_probe.note: Frozen weights on the specified recorded actual batches; no optimizer step. Components use the original full-batch denominator and rank weight. Gradient norms are not additive shares; signed projections onto the total sum to one and may be negative. Historical optimizer-time gradients were not recorded.

meaning: From-scratch sampling-distribution control only: same raw exact corpus, held-out queries, model, Sigmoid, physical distance, Huber/soft-rank losses, budget and validation selector as the original Sokoban baseline. Improves within-layout completion, but does not solve unseen layouts.
